structured_output.what_is_happening: YAP (AXAd…Ech) is a 36-minute-old PumpSwap pair. It was not a pump.fun bonding-curve graduation. The creator seeded it directly, and it says it was "Created on useyap.fun". Market cap is $160k but liquidity is $226k, so liquidity is larger than the market cap. That means the creator put in an unusually large amount of SOL, and none of the LP is locked or burned. In 35 minutes the pair traded $5.7M, 25x its liquidity, and price rose about 118%. Price is now fading: -1.6% to -6% over the last 5 minutes, just below the all-time high. The buyer and seller counts are very lopsided. There were about 1,261 unique buyers but only 61 unique sellers, and those 61 wallets made about 3,300 sell transactions. GMGN also flags 49 bundler wallets holding about 23% of top-trader share. This looks like a small group of controlled wallets cycling volume and selling into retail buys. It does not look like organic two-way trading.

narrative.description: The coin is tied to the useyap.fun launchpad or 'yap' brand and appears to be a platform or brand ticker. The only social link is an X status link for @useyapdotfun, not a real profile. There is no website profile on DexScreener and no paid promotion.
narrative.why_spreading: The attention seems to come from the volume itself: huge turnover and a +118% move landing on screeners. A crowded field of same-ticker coins suggests people are chasing the 'YAP' name. There is no evidence of organic social spread.

token_connection.why_this_token: Its description names useyap.fun and it links to the useyapdotfun X account, so it may be affiliated with the platform.
token_connection.competing_tokens: jLz71…dyap (vanity 'yap' suffix, likely also from useyap.fun) launched about 3.4h earlier and sits at $833k market cap with $1.07M hourly volume. It is the bigger and more likely canonical YAP. Several pump.fun YAP copies with near-zero liquidity also launched in the same window.

authenticity.evidence: The buyer/seller split is extreme: 61 unique sellers against 1,261 buyers, with about 3,300 sells. There are 49 bundler wallets and 25x hourly turnover on a pool the creator seeded. The LP is 0% locked, and RugCheck warns that only a few wallets provide liquidity. There are no smart-money or KOL wallets, and GMGN shows only 1 page visit.
authenticity.uncertainty: The launchpad may run bots or market-making by design, which would inflate the seller-side counts without meaning a rug. The GMGN buyer counts could include bot wallets.

structural_risks: The LP is fully unlocked and the creator seeded it, so the creator can pull $226k at any time
Selling is concentrated in about 61 wallets, which points to wash trading or insider distribution
Momentum is already rolling over near the all-time high
A larger same-ticker competitor exists, and the canonical YAP is unclear
Non-standard launchpad with no pump.fun curve protections

structured_output.counterargument: If useyap.fun is a real launchpad and this is its official token, 1,261 unique buyers in 35 minutes is real retail demand. Liquidity above market cap means slippage is low, and the top-10 holders (excluding the pool) own only 11.6%. A 2x to about $320k market cap is a small absolute move, well under the sibling YAP's $833k, and could happen if people rotate out of the bigger YAP.

structured_output.thesis: The creator seeded the PumpSwap pool and the LP is fully unlocked. Volume looks wash-traded, with about 61 sellers against about 1,261 buyers, and GMGN flags heavy bundler activity. Price is already fading from +118% near its high, and a bigger YAP from what looks like the same launchpad competes for the ticker. The setup looks like a distribution or LP-pull event. Another 2x before a -50% move or a rug seems unlikely.
